errors.Is matches stage.ErrMaxRoundsExceeded; errors.As *stage.MaxRoundsError gives the limit
max_tool_calls_per_turn: calls over the limit are not run, get an error result, next round offers no tools
tool_choice is auto, required or none; none sends no tools
blocklist: tools the prompt may not run even when listed in tools
tool_policy exists only on a prompt, no pack-level tool_policy

sdk.WithToolPolicy sets the tool policy for every tool loop the conversation runs (text, VAD voice, workflow states, composition steps); a realtime duplex session runs tool calls outside the loop
Host-only ToolPolicy limits are MaxCallsPerMinute, MaxCostUSD, MaxIdenticalToolCalls, MaxParallelToolCalls and StopOnTool
MaxCallsPerMinute is checked and counted only when a call is admitted to run; held calls on approval, client calls on use of the result; over-limit calls do not run
MaxCostUSD sums cost recorded on the history given to the loop; the round that crosses it fails with 'provider stage: cost budget exceeded'
MaxIdenticalToolCalls defaults to 3 and MaxParallelToolCalls defaults to 10
Host and prompt policies merge: lower of MaxRounds and MaxToolCallsPerTurn, union of Blocklist, host ToolChoice else prompt's, other fields the host's
A composition agent step's termination.tool_called replaces StopOnTool for that step and a prompt step always runs one round
tool_policy has four keys (blocklist, max_rounds, max_tool_calls_per_turn, tool_choice); with schema validation skipped an unknown key is ignored and logged with the prompt and key
